blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: During extended wakefulness, mammalian neocortical networks experience localized periods of transient neuronal silence termed off-states. Here, we examine how analogous spatiotemporally concentrated disruptions affect sequential reasoning in autoregressive Large Language Models (LLMs). Evaluating 250 paired derivations on the GSM8K benchmark across two 8B models (Qwen3-8B and LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct), we contrast clustered bursts of attention head masking against budget-matched diffuse i.i.d. dropout. Concentrated bursts induce substantial reasoning degradation: at onset parameter $\mathcal{B}=0.10$ (scheduling $\sim 5.7\%$ of vulnerable head-token volume), Qwen3-8B accuracy drops from $91.2\%$ under diffuse noise to $78.8\%$ under burst dropout ($Δ= -12.4$ percentage points [pp], exact McNemar $p = 5.5 \times 10^{-6}$), while LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct drops from $84.0\%$ to $76.8\%$ ($Δ= -7.2$ pp, $p = 0.0198$). Conversely, dispersing the identical cumulative budget uniformly across generation steps via stratified quintile matching yields substantially milder degradation (retaining $91.2\%$ in Qwen and $84.0\%$ in LLaMA). In an exploratory factorial dissociation ($N=100$), single-step dropout density is associated with an acute drop in a single schedule draw ($-10.0$ pp on Qwen, $p_{\text{holm}} = 0.0425$), while multi-token continuity exhibits an inconclusive compounding trend ($-7.0$ pp, $p_{\text{holm}} = 0.1892$). Error analysis reveals that Qwen failures reflect derivation errors within formatted responses (conditional accuracy drop of $-11.4$ pp), whereas in LLaMA $22.2\%$ of discordant losses lack a final answer format line (conditional gap narrows to $-5.0$ pp). These findings demonstrate that autoregressive reasoning chains are particularly vulnerable to concentrated structural disruptions, providing empirical benchmarks for fault tolerance in transformer architectures.
blocks.zh: 在长时间的觉醒期间,哺乳动物新科网络经历了局部的短暂神经沉默时期,被称为"异态". 在这里,我们研究类似的瞬息万变的集中中断如何影响自旋性大语言模型(LLMs)的相继推理. 在两个8B模型(Qune3-8B和LLaMA-31-8B-Instruct)上,对GSM8K基准的250对衍生物进行了评估,我们对比了注意力罩与预算相匹配的分散即辍学的组合。 集中的暴发引起大量推理退化:在发端参数为$\mathcal{B}=0.10美元(将5.7美元左右的易碎头孔体积)时,Qune3-8B的精度从扩散噪声下的91.2美元下降到78.8美元(Δ=-12.4个百分点[pp],准确的McNemar $p = 5.5\tims 10^{-6}美元;LLaMA-3.1-8B-指令从84.0美元下降到76.8美元(Δ=-7.2pp,$p = 0.0198美元)。 反之,通过分级的五分位数匹配,将相同的累积预算统一分散到各代人之间,其退化程度大大减轻(Quen省为91.2美元,LLaMA省为84.0美元)。 在探索性因子分离中(一美元=100美元),单步退学密度与单行时间表抽取的急速下降有关(一美元为Quen,一美元为-0.0美元;一美元为-text{holm}=0.0425美元),而多键接续显示的复合趋势没有结果(一美元为-7.0美元;一美元为-text{holm}=0.1892美元)。 错误分析显示,Quen故障反映了格式化答复中的出处错误(有条件的准确度下降为11.4美元pp),而在LLaMA22.2美元中,不协调者损失没有最后的答案格式行(有条件的缺口缩小为5.0美元pp)。 这些调查结果表明,自转推理链特别容易受到集中的结构中断的影响,为变压器结构的容错性提供了经验基准.

blocks.en: Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: In biological neuroscience, the classical view of sleep as an exclusively global brain state mediated solely by subcortical arousal nuclei has been revised following the discovery of local sleep in awake neocortical networks [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] . Under extended wakefulness and sleep deprivation, individual cortical columns and localized neuronal assemblies spontaneously undergo transient periods of neuronal silence and slow-wave electrophysiological activity, termed cortical off-states or microsleeps, even as the organism remains awake and active [ 1 , 4 ] . In awake humans, these intruding localized off-states predict cognitive lapses during tasks that require continuous, sequential mental operations [ 2 , 5 ] .
blocks.zh: 在生物神经科学中,在觉醒新科网络中发现局部睡眠[1,2,3]后,修改了仅由亚正弦核来调节的全全球大脑状态的古典观点. 在长时间的失眠和睡眠剥夺的情况下,单个皮质柱和局部神经元组分自发地经历神经静默和缓波电生活性的短暂时期,称为皮质外状态或微睡眠,即使机体保持清醒和活性[1,4]. 在被唤醒的人类中,这些干扰的局部地外状态预测,在需要连续,相继的精神手术的任务中,认知会失效[2,5].

blocks.en: In artificial intelligence, Large Language Models (LLMs) parameterized by deep transformer architectures have proven effective at solving multi-step logical tasks [ 6 , 7 , 8 ] . In Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning, complex problems are decomposed into sequential token trajectories. Intermediate arithmetic calculations, variable groundings, and inferential deductions are generated autoregressively and appended to the context history [ 9 , 10 , 11 ] . Attention heads act as dynamic routing channels, reading relevant historical representations from the Key–Value (KV) cache to compute successive tokens [ 12 , 13 ] .
blocks.zh: 在人工智能中,由深变压器架构所分解的"大语言模型"(LLM)参数已被证明能有效解决多步逻辑任务[6,7,8]. 在"思考链"(Cain-of-though (CoT))推理中,复杂的问题被分解为相继的符号轨迹. 中间算法计算、可变地基和推算法是自动产生的,并附在上下文史上[9、10、11]。 注意头作为动态路由通道,从键-Value (KV)缓存读取相关的历史代表来计算相继的符 [12,13].

blocks.en: While the fault tolerance of transformer attention has been analyzed in the context of post-training structural pruning [ 14 , 15 ] , isotropic weight degradation, and uniform pre-training dropout [ 16 ] , dynamic runtime noise models commonly adopt an independent and identically distributed (i.i.d.) perturbation schedule. Under uniform i.i.d. perturbations, omissions are dispersed uniformly at random across the spatio-temporal volume of the network. However, autoregressive computation exhibits an unrolled temporal dependency structure, where the output token generated at step t t conditions all subsequent representations at steps t + 1 , t + 2 , … , T t+1,t+2,\dots,T .
blocks.zh: 虽然在训练后结构挤压[14,15],异热带重量下降,以及统一训练前辍学[16]的背景下,对变压器注意力的断层耐受性进行了分析,但动态跑时噪声模型通常采用独立且分布相同的(即一.d.)扰动时间表. 在统一一.一.一.一.一.一.扰动下,遗漏在网络的斯皮提-时积中随机地统一分散. 然而,自旋式计算显示一个未滚动的时间依赖结构,其中在步 t t 生成的输出符在步骤 t + 1, t + 2 ,..., T + 1,t+2,\dots, T 中附加了所有后续的表示.

blocks.en: This structural asymmetry raises two practical questions regarding the robustness of autoregressive reasoning: first, whether spatiotemporally concentrated attention head failure (co-activating head omissions across layers and successive tokens) inflicts a more severe reasoning breakdown than an equal cumulative budget of diffuse (i.i.d.) noise, and second, whether the resulting impairment is driven primarily by instantaneous per-step intensity (dense head loss within a single token) or by temporal multi-token continuity (sustained disruption over consecutive tokens).
blocks.zh: 这种结构不对称提出了两个关于自相递减推理的稳健性的实际问题:第一,spatient-content attention admincept (跨层和相继信号)导致的推理崩溃比扩散(即d.)噪声的等同累积预算更严重;第二,由此产生的障碍是主要由瞬时的相继强度(一个相继信号中剧烈的头部损失)还是由时间的多键连续(相继信号持续中断)所驱动。

blocks.en: To evaluate these questions with paired experimental control, we conduct confirmatory evaluations ( N = 250 N=250 items) and an exploratory factorial dissociation experiment ( N = 100 N=100 ) on two modern 8-billion-parameter open-weight models: Qwen3-8B [ 17 ] and LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct [ 18 ] on the GSM8K benchmark [ 9 ] . We show that concentrated bursts trigger significant derivation impairment ( Δ = − 12.4 \Delta=-12.4 pp on Qwen, Δ = − 7.2 \Delta=-7.2 pp on LLaMA at nominal onset parameter ℬ = 0.10 \mathcal{B}=0.10 ), while matched budgets of diffuse i.i.d. noise result in comparatively modest losses. Furthermore, we evaluate instantaneous per-step density and multi-token continuity, finding that single-step concentration produces an acute drop in that draw ( − 10.0 -10.0 pp on Qwen, p holm = 0.0425 p_{\text{holm}}=0.0425 ), with multi-token continuity acting as a suggestive compounding trend.

blocks.en: Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论情况

blocks.en: Residual Stream Buffering and Density Differences
blocks.zh: 残余流缓冲和密度差异

blocks.en: Our findings show a clear distinction between diffuse and concentrated attention head dropouts. When omissions are dispersed uniformly across generation steps as low-density noise, the models exhibit comparatively modest degradation, with Qwen losing 2.4 2.4 pp and LLaMA losing 3.2 3.2 pp relative to clean baseline accuracy at ℬ = 0.10 \mathcal{B}=0.10 .
blocks.zh: 我们的调查结果明确区分了分散注意力和集中注意力的辍学者。 当作为低密度噪声在生成步骤之间统一分散时,模型的降解程度相对较小,与B = 0.10\ mathcal{B = 0.10的清洁基线精度相比,Quen损失2.4 2.4 pp,LLaMA损失3.2 3.2 pp.

blocks.en: However, when head loss concentrates spatiotemporally, performance declines sharply. Silencing 40 % 40\% of attention heads in the upper layers simultaneously appears to exceed the compensatory capacity of surviving channels, resulting in invalid derivations or missing answer lines.
blocks.zh: 然而,当头部损失集中时,性能会急剧下降。 上层40%的注意力头被静住,似乎同时超过了生存通道的补偿能力,导致无效衍生或缺失答案行.

blocks.en: The Autoregressive Attractor Trap Hypothesis
blocks.zh: 自动反向吸引器陷阱假说

blocks.en: To conceptually interpret how transient bursts may trigger persistent derivation errors, we formulate the Autoregressive Attractor Trap Hypothesis as a multi-stage process.
blocks.zh: 为了从概念上解释瞬间暴发如何触发持续的衍生出错误,我们提出自动反向吸引器陷阱假说,作为一个多阶段过程。

blocks.en: Multi-step mathematical reasoning naturally forms a sequential dependency graph in which each downstream deduction conditions upon prior tokens. During an attention burst, representational starvation induces disruption through two distinct channels: first, discrete token commitment, where the decoder emits an erroneous intermediate token or premature conclusion into the context history, and second, continuous representational contamination, where perturbed residual stream vectors x t ( l ) x_{t}^{(l)} generate corrupted Key and Value vectors in all subsequent layers l ′ > l l^{\prime}>l , which are written permanently into the KV cache.
blocks.zh: 多步骤数学推理自然形成相继的依附图,其中每个下游在前作符号上的扣减条件. 在注意力爆发期间,代表性饥饿通过两个不同渠道引起干扰:第一,离散符号承诺,即解码器将错误的中间符号或过早结论放入背景历史;第二,持续的代表性污染,即扰动残余溪流向量x t (l) x_{t}^{ (l)}在以后的所有地层中产生腐烂的密钥和价值向量l ' > l^{\prime}>l,这些被永久写入了KV缓存.

blocks.en: Because autoregressive decoders append both emitted tokens and Key–Value vectors permanently into memory, these corrupted representations become immutable conditioning context [ 10 ] . Upon recovery of full attention capacity, subsequent unperturbed heads attend to this corrupted context, trapping the forward trajectory in an erroneous attractor basin from which greedy decoding cannot escape. We emphasize that this mechanism is framed strictly as an interpretative model rather than a proven causal theorem, as surgical KV-cache state rollback was not performed.
blocks.zh: 由于自递性解码器将释放的符和键 - 值向量永久地附加入内存,这些被腐蚀的表达式成为了不可变的上下文 [10] 。 在完全恢复了注意力能力后,随后的未受干扰的头目会关注这种被腐蚀的背景,将前行轨迹困入一个错误的吸引器盆地中,而贪婪的解码无法从中逃脱. 我们强调,这一机制严格地说是一个解释性模型,而不是一个经过证明的因果定理,因为没有进行外科KV-cache状态回滚。

blocks.en: Architectural Divergence and Derivation Lengths
blocks.zh: 建筑差异和衍生长度

blocks.en: Qwen3-8B and LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct exhibit distinct vulnerability profiles. Qwen3-8B features 36 layers and generates longer Chain-of-Thought derivations on GSM8K, yielding higher realized head-token volumes ( 8,897.3 8,897.3 vs. 6,626.4 6,626.4 at ℬ = 0.10 \mathcal{B}=0.10 ). We hypothesize post hoc that longer derivation trajectories offer a larger temporal target surface for corrupting omissions, potentially explaining Qwen’s steeper decline at ℬ = 0.10 \mathcal{B}=0.10 and its acute vulnerability to single-step concentration ( Δ ​ t = 1 \Delta t=1 ). Conversely, LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct produces more concise derivations, with a notable fraction of its deficit reflecting format and answer omissions.

blocks.en: Computational Neuroscience Analogies: Biological vs. Artificial Networks
blocks.zh: 计算神经科学类比:生物与人工网络

blocks.en: These results provide a conceptual parallel to cortical dynamics during sleep deprivation. In awake mammals, sleep deprivation triggers localized cortical off-states in isolated neuronal assemblies [ 1 , 2 ] . In humans, these intrusions predict cognitive lapses during tasks that require continuous, sequential attention [ 5 ] .
blocks.zh: 这些结果在概念上与睡眠被剥夺期间的皮质动力学平行. 在醒去的哺乳动物中,睡眠剥夺触发了被隔离的神经元集合[1,2]的局部皮质外立体. 在人类中,这些入侵预测在需要连续,相继关注的任务中认知会失效[5].

blocks.en: Artificial autoregressive networks exhibit a functionally related vulnerability: they are resilient to diffuse, unstructured noise, but vulnerable to concentrated disruptions that sever sequential reasoning chains. However, this biological analogy is operational rather than physiological. Artificial attention heads perform dot-product associative routing across token vectors, distinct from electrochemical synaptic transmission and spiking dynamics in biological cortical columns.
blocks.zh: 人工自旋网络在功能上具有脆弱性:它们能够抵御扩散的、无结构的噪音,但易受集中干扰,从而断断顺序推理链。 然而,这种生物学类比是实用的,而不是生理的. 人工注意力头执行点-产物相接的通路,跨越了信使向量,区别于电化学突触传导和生物皮质柱中跃起的动力学.

blocks.en: First, regarding budget realization and schedule stochasticity, scheduled budgets were planned across the nominal horizon of T max = 512 T_{\text{max}}=512 tokens. Because GSM8K derivations terminate early upon emitting EOS tokens (averaging an estimated ∼ 221 \sim 221 – 273 273 tokens based on realized-to-scheduled ratios), realized budgets represented 43 % 43\% – 53 % 53\% of scheduled budgets. Furthermore, generating mask schedules via stochastic Bernoulli trials induces item-level variance. The dissociation experiment utilized a 10-step refractory jump rather than the 7-step jump of confirmatory runs, altering scheduled dose by ∼ 13 % \sim 13\% . On the identical 100 items, the confirmatory schedule yielded a reference contrast of − 6.0 -6.0 pp on Qwen and − 5.0 -5.0 pp on LLaMA, whereas the dissociation draw yielded − 17.0 -17.0 pp and − 2.0 -2.0 pp, indicating that single-draw evaluations carry substantial schedule variance.

blocks.en: Third, regarding mechanistic and architectural scope, in the Spaced control, interleaved tokens were masked using the identical sampled subset of heads across the burst window, while a control resampling fresh heads at each step was not evaluated. In addition, our masking operator intervenes on the output projection W O W_{O} , zeroing query contextual contributions to the residual stream without performing surgical KV cache state manipulation. While past unmasked tokens retain unperturbed cache vectors, Key and Value projections for current step t t in all subsequent layers l ′ > l l^{\prime}>l ( k t ( l ′ , j ) , v t ( l ′ , j ) k_{t}^{(l^{\prime},j)},v_{t}^{(l^{\prime},j)} ) are computed from the perturbed residual stream and stored in cache, persisting across all future decoding steps. Finally, reasoning was evaluated zero-shot with thinking disabled on a single mathematical benchmark (GSM8K), and full generation transcripts were not written to disk during evaluation runs.
